test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only one person sits between P and O when counted from the right of P. Only one person sits between O and X when counted from the right of O. Only one person sits between P and W when counted from the right of W. Only two people sit between N and X when counted from the right of N. Only one person sits between M and W when counted from the right of M. Who sits third to the right of Y?
solution: **Given: **M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. 1. Only one person sits between P and O when counted from the right of P. 2. Only one person sits between O and X when counted from the right of O. 3. Only one person sits between P and W when counted from the right of W. 4. Only two people sit between N and X when counted from the right of N. 5. Only one person sits between M and W when counted from the right of M.
